verdict.rationale: Token2's docs describe FIDO2 keys that work through standard browser WebAuthn flows without special tooling (browsers prompt for a PIN when needed) and demo WebAuthn registration and login. Microsoft is explicitly covered via Entra ID enrollment and Intune passwordless guides. However, the pack names none of the other major services the story lists. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of compatibility with Google, GitHub and password managers; any mention of U2F/CTAP1 legacy support; independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-service use.
